about: Rules of the pregame learning loop. Every weight group (category) is re-tested each week on games its candidate values never saw. Nothing here is tuned by the loop itself.

categories.name: Rating ingredients
categories.what: how the team ratings weigh yards, efficiency (EPA) and points scored

categories.name: Memory
categories.what: how fast older games fade from the ratings

categories.name: Sample trust
categories.what: how many games a team needs before its own numbers outweigh the league average

categories.name: Season carryover
categories.what: how much of last season a team carries into the new one

categories.name: Home field
categories.what: points added for playing at home (none at neutral sites)

categories.name: Backup quarterback
categories.what: points of margin a team loses when its usual starter is out

categories.name: Win-probability calibration
categories.what: how a projected margin turns into a win probability

categories.name: Blend with Vegas
categories.what: how much of GridIron's own number goes into the blended line

categories.name: Venue edge
categories.what: extra home edge for venues that have measured tougher or softer than average

categories.name: Rest days
categories.what: points per extra day of rest over the opponent

categories.name: Weather on the total
categories.what: points added to or taken off the game total for a roof, sustained wind and cold

categories.name: Referee crew
categories.what: points added to the total for a referee whose recent games have run over or under the line
